string.text: Scientist conducting research in the Zone.
Dead stalker
モノリスの哨兵。重要な地位にあるとみられる。極めて危険で行動も予測できない。十分な警戒が必要だ。詳細不明。
A stalker from the Monolith group. Heavy ordnance expert, familiar with construction of IEDs, caution advised due to risk of suicide attack. No details available.
A stalker from the Monolith group. Expert marksman, effective in tactical sharpshooting and camouflage. Caution advised. No details available.
モノリスのストーカー。あらゆる既知の防具に対して極めて高い殺傷力を持つ、磁気推進式の試作兵器を装備している。十分な警戒が必要だ。詳細不明。
A stalker from the Monolith group. Well equipped and tactically proficient, possible special forces origins, extremely dangerous in squads. Severe caution advised. No details available.
Commander of the military raid.
Military grunt. Well armed and highly dangerous.
Military sharpshooter. Equipped with long range scope, lethal sniping skills.
Army Spetsnaz. Well equipped special forces professional, excellent tactical training and experience.
Vasil Luckless
Army Spetsnaz. Well equipped special forces personnel, excellent tactical training and experience.
Former digger who raids all the desolate laboratories and bunkers he and his associates come across.
Mole
One of the many participants of the deadly fights in the Arena.
Manager of the Arena. Owes his position to Duty.
Arnie
Bouncer at the bar. Also Barkeep's personal bodyguard. Nothing is known about his present or past activities, the man is a blank slate.
Garik
Garik's twin brother. Bouncer at the bar. As close-mouthed as his brother.
Zhorik

Neither a saint, nor a scoundrel. The Barkeep knows his worth and is respected by all stalkers. Rumor has it he is hiding in the Zone from some dark events in his past. After an encounter with an anomaly, his never healed right and his limp forced him to change careers. He set up a bar at the Duty base, and the place gradually turned into the favorite watering hole and meeting spot for all of the Zone's veterans. The Barkeep has since acquired numerous connections both in the Zone and in the outside world, and has began to run smuggling operations across the border of the Zone. Supplies come in, Artifacts and mutant parts go out.
Barkeep
Beast

Member of the Duty faction, has fallen hopelessly in love with vodka, but the feeling is not mutual. Duty gave him his one last chance for redemption by carrying out an important mission. However, he was too drunk to get himself together and hasn't managed to pull it off.
Brome

Good-natured, cheerful guy whose only problem is that he can't shoot from anything other than a solid hunting rifle. Hunter hasn't even tried any other firearms, all that matters to him is his own rifle. He recently got into a scrap in the Wild Territory and lost his precious shooter, a family heirloom to boot. Since then, lurking about the bar, seeking to employ a seasoned stalker to help him search for the treasured, antique weapon.
Hunter
Mysterious, self-professed "know-it-all" stalker. Trades information in the bar in exchange for cash. Probably a swindler.
Snitch
Commander of all punitive raids and expeditions against significant mutant threats.
Captain Ivantsov
Sgt. Kitsenko
The Arena manager's bodyguard. Not much is known about his past, what little is known is all pretty bad, speculations are even worse. Apparently, he hates his brothers.
Liolik
Baldy

One of Duty's founders and the leading driving force behind their anti-Zone ideology. Responsible for writing the faction's code of honor, which is protected and obeyed with an almost religious fervor. He recruited many of Duty's key members of today.
Colonel Petrenko
Chief of Duty's territorial security forces, originally from Russia. Ex-spetsnaz operative, was a fire-team leader and knows how to set up effective choke-points and defensive cordons.
Sgt. Plichko
A stranger with a few loose screws, apparently affected by the Brain Scorcher.
Spotty

One of the Duty's original founders and the key behind the organization's efficient structure and operational effectiveness. Widely reputed as an inspiration to his subordinates. He still has significant influence within the Military leadership hierarchy.
General Voronin
Judging by the smell, a serious alcoholic.
Unknown stalker, with an unsavory reputation.
Known organized crime member in the Zone, poor reputation amongst the loners.
One of the notorious bandit leaders. Well armed and highly dangerous, likely organized crime member in the outside world.
Borziy
Doc.
Doc
Unknown mercenary. Well armored in prototype exo-skeleton and highly dangerous.
Unknown mercenary. Decent equipment and training.
Merc squad leader. Well armed and highly dangerous.
Dushman
Experienced stalker. No details available.
Vasily Petrovich
No information available.
Experienced stalker. Always keeps his eyes open.
Zheka Doublet
Kalugin P.I.
Regular sergeant in the Ukrainian Army. Standard issue armament, experienced in combat.
Regular private in the Ukrainian Army. Standard issue armament, poor combat experience.
Unknown stalker, pretty much a nobody.
Long service captain of the Ukrainian Army. Well armed and tactically proficient.
Took over leadership at the rookie camp after Wolf. Full of purpose, an aggressive defender, has earned well-deserved respect from newcomers.
Fanatic
An experienced loner toughened by the Zone.
Fox
Unknown mercenary. Part of a special purpose hit squad, lethal tactics and excellent special force grade equipment.
Smart rookie, has potential to climb up the ranks quickly. Wolf seems to like him and often sends him out on important missions.
Petruha

A living legend of sorts. They say he can take you to absolutely any place in the Zone. His services are costly and not available for just anyone. If he doesn't like you, he won't take you anywhere, even for all the money in the world. A veteran, has paved his way through the length and breadth of the Zone many times over.
Guide
Regular sergeant in the Ukrainian Army. Decent experience, standard issue armament.

A stalker who earned his nickname by being nearly invisible and truly indispensable with sensitive matters. The trader turns to him for important missions such as reconnaissance, espionage and item retrieval.
Nimble

A Major in command of the Military checkpoint by the railway bridge. Known for happily taking bribes from stalkers who wish to pass his checkpoint unharmed. He has a rocky relationship with the Trader although there is mutual respect between them, and deals are often worked out which benefit both men.
Major Kuznetsov
Regular private in the Ukrainian Army. Standard military armament and poor combat experience.
Spetsnaz operative. Well equipped and highly trained. Caution advised.
Unknown mercenary. Well armed and highly trained, possibly special forces origin. Caution advised.
Rookie stalker. New to the Zone, not likely to live long.
Average rookie stalker, shows some potential.
Tolik
Head of the rookie camp, helps Sidorovich keep everyone in check. An old, experienced stalker with experience in deep raids into the Zone, some say he plans to go back to his calling.
Wolf

A merchant with an affinity for trade straight out of the cradle. In kindergarten, he used to sell crayons. In high school, he took to selling chewing gum. At the Institute, he dealt in light drugs. As soon as the Zone came to be, he realized its money-making potential. Famous for being able to build strong trade relations with any kind of ill-sorted clients.
Sidorovich
Has certain authority with the bandits in the Zone. Borov's sidekick.
Vasya Boar
A stalker from the Duty faction.
Officer in the Duty faction.
Warrant officer
Rookie. Trying to make it big in the Zone.
Yurik
Hiding in the Zone from the law. Tries to maintain order in the Zone on his terms. Fights against the bandits. Cruel but fair.
Bes
Rookie. New to the zone, greener than freshly mowed grass.
Stalker with a face as dirty as his conscience.
Seriy
An experienced stalker, been around the Zone a while now.
Militant from the Duty faction. Exceptional training and kit.
Commander of a special forces detachment of the Duty faction. Particularly well equipped.
Skull
A fighter from the Duty faction. Very well equipped, possible special forces training.
An informant known across the whole Zone, a regular stool pigeon.
Ara
Unknown mercenary. Highly trained, heavily armed, likely squad leader. Caution advised.
Unknown mercenary. Apparent marksman training, possibly ex-military sharpshooter.
Unknown mercenary. Trained up to spec ops level, very well equipped.
Squad leader of the Monolith group. Fanatical and erratic, avoid at all cost.
Stalker from the Monolith group. Expert fighter, totally devoted to the protection of the Zone's center.
One of the veterans. Knows the Zone like the back of his hand. Usually well equipped and highly dangerous. No details available.
Highly experienced stalker. Well equipped, knows what's what in the Zone.
Stalker from the Freedom faction. Barrier commander. The man who banded together a group of people willing to sacrifice their lives for the common cause.
Cap
Bodyguard working for Lukash, the leader of the Freedom faction.
The cook of the Freedom faction. A boozer and a brawler, but an excellent cook.
Chef
A mechanic renowned throughout the Zone. Can make a tank out of a tractor or so the story goes.
Screw
Leader of the Freedom faction.
Lukash
Squad leader of the Freedom faction. Knows the Zone like his own pockets.
Member of the Freedom faction. A fanatic devoted to the cause. Very well equipped and highly dangerous.
Max
Member of the Freedom faction. Very well equipped, born survivor.
Murk
Stalker from the Freedom faction. Familiar with the dangers of the Zone, knows how to get by.
Sniper from the Freedom faction. Excellent sharp-shooting skills.
Militant from the Freedom faction. Very well trained, possibly ex-special forces.
A Stalker belonging to the Freedom faction, experienced traveler of the Zone.
Pavlik
Infamous for his greed and disobedience, it is admittedly rumored he can get his hands on anything.
Skinflint
A stalker belonging to the Freedom faction, he's had better days.
Insane stalker from the Freedom faction.
Militant from the Freedom faction. Well equipped, experienced with mutants and anomalies.
Sasha Belly
A veteran stalker. Well equipped, highly experienced.
Stalker from the Monolith group, completely devoted to his clan.
Elite stalker from the Monolith group, a walking tank sporting an exoskeleton.
Leader of a Monolith hit squad. Dangerous and fanatical, won't think twice before deciding to waste someone.
Charon
Regular stalker from the Monolith group. May seem like an average Joe, but his experience in the Zone cannot be underestimated.
Stalker from the special forces of the Monolith faction. Very lethal tactical skill, caution advised.
Based on the tattered uniform, used to be a Ukraine Army grunt. Not sure what he is now.
Zombified soldier
One of the stalkers who ran out of luck and got his brains fried.
Zombified stalker
Commander of a Duty combat squad. Very well equipped and trained, possible background in the military.
A scientist, likely member of the Ecologist faction.
Scientists' security detail. Ecologists never leave camp without them.
Research Assistant.
Researcher.
Senior leadership from the Monolith faction. Person of importance, commands great respect from his peers.
Militant from the Monolith group. Well equipped and highly trained, possibly ex-special forces origin.
Spetsnaz operative. Best training and equipment Ukraine's Military has to offer.
One of the legendary loner veterans. Knows the Zone like the back of his own hand. Usually well equipped and highly dangerous.
A Stalker veteran. Has seen almost all that the Zone has to offer, and lived to tell the story.
Squad Leader of the Freedom faction. Skilled survivor of the Zone, able to skirt around mutants and anomalies without effort.
One of the stalkers who ran out of luck.
An armed research assistant, provides security over-watch during science expeditions.
A scientist with experience operating in the Zone, expert on anomalous phenomena. Worked in America on top secret projects. Reported missing in the outside world for a while now.
Freeman

An opportunistic looter and a murderer. Has a fat price on his head. Formerly on good terms with Duty, helped them win over some of their territory. Now dwells in the Wild Territory and mugs lonely stalkers with his gang.
Lucky
Ph.D. in biology. Wrote several papers on pathogenic mutations in animals back in the outside world. Came to the Zone to study mutations of the local wildlife.
Professor Kruglov

One of the most infamous mercenaries operating in the Zone, considered a "hero" by his fellow contractors. A veteran of many firefights with bullets of all calibers still lodged in his body, considered by him as trophies. Known for being a pure psychopath and a sadist.
Tyran

One of the more notorious Mercenary field commanders. The leader of the merc gang calling themselves "The Curs". An anarchist despising all man-made laws except the law of the jungle, survival of the fittest.
Wolfhound
Stalker from the Monolith group. A dangerous fanatic, not afraid of dying for his cause.
A stalker from the Monolith's special group called "Crystal," responsible for the safety of the mysterious Monolith itself.
Arnie
Beast
Vasya "Boar"
A psycho-material form created by the Monolith.
Borov
Insane stalker.
Warrant officer
Security Chief

Yurik

"Wolf"
A bandit gang leader, and a ruthless cutthroat.
A veteran bandit, commands his own gang of thieves and looters. Knows the Zone well, and knows where the loners can be shaken down easily.

Came to the Zone looking for adventure. Good at imitating characters from popular comics of the 60s. Uses different names: Badman, Macho, the Black Coat, Banderos. Even though he has survived in the Zone for two whole years, no one really takes him seriously and it constantly drives him mad.

Fierce, wicked, crude, selfish, cruel, insensitive, cold. Nobody knows when and how he got to the Zone. Everyone fears him and for that reason he has no known friends. He simply exists in the Zone, with no future and no past. After one of his numerous forays into the center, he lost his memory, forgetting nearly everything. He doesn’t remember where he comes from, doesn’t remember his real name, suffers from frequent lapses of memory. Known to completely forget his new acquaintances within an hour, often leading him to attack those he forgets, confusing them as looters.
Pathetic loner turned to banditry.
A veteran bandit, knows where to look for loot and where to administer pain to get stash locations out of captured loners.
Veteran member of the Duty faction. Doesn't trust strangers, has an itchy trigger finger, caution advised.
A stalker with the Duty faction. Solid gear and decent training.
A sharpshooter from the Duty faction. An excellent shot, with or without a scope.

A known cad, bootlicker, hypocrite and coward. Barin’s motto could as well be, "After us, the Deluge". Takes advantage of any situation. Extremely ambitious and touchy. He came to the Zone, unsurprisingly, for money. For two years now he's been procuring and hoarding material assets by all possible means.
Militant veteran from the Duty faction. Well equipped and experienced with most things the Zone has to offer.

Official recruiter for the Ukrainian Security Services. A frequent visitor of the bar. Everyone knows who he is, as well as the fact that he is the man to turn to when you fall on hard times. However, once you cross this line, there is no way back to the ranks of the honest stalkers.

In everyday life a phlegmatic who keeps his emotions to himself and always stays cool. However, when under stress, he gets peppery and aggressive. Highly intellectual. A materialist regretting he had come to the Zone in the first place. After graduating from the medical university, was sent into the Zone where the scientists’ camp needed a neurosurgeon assistant. Dissects mutant brains and researches their psychokinetic properties. Looking forward to his retirement when he can move back to the big land, as far as possible from this rotten place.
One of the stalkers who ran out of luck.
Unknown mercenary squad leader. Extremely well armed and disciplined, exercises solid tactical judgment, likely special forces command origin.
Mercenary squad leader. Commands utmost respect from his men, runs his squad like a professional spec-ops fire-team.
Unknown mercenary sniper. Skills indicate military sniping background.
Unknown mercenary veteran. Weathered look of his gear indicates he has spent more time in the Zone than he'd care to admit.
An expert stalker from the Monolith faction. Dangerous fanatic, jerky, unpredictable but thoroughly disciplined and devoted to his cause.
A stalker from the Monolith faction. Experienced and unpredictable, known for willingness to take the ultimate sacrifice if it means victory.
Stalker from the Monolith group, sniping expert. Known for ability to lay in wait for days, subsisting off the land, while watching for hostiles.
Stalker from the Monoliths special hit squads. Undoubtedly ex special-forced background, very good tactical sense.
A military grunt with distinguished insignia. From his uniform, seems like a higher ranking officer.
Military stalker, spent a very long time in the Zone. Knows how to avoid the dangers which his colleagues often stumble into blindly.
Regular soldier. Standard kit of the Ukrainian army, total rookie, immature and sadistic.
Military sniper. Effective use of scoped rifles, caution advised.
Spetsnaz operative. Ukraine military's finest, expert combatant with best local gear.
Highly experienced stalker, mentor to many loners. Highly experienced with survival in the Zone and artifact hunting.

Stalker born under a lucky star. Many times, the teams he was with would end up in tight spots and every time he was the only survivor. Most stalkers stay away from him on account of the bad luck he is said to bring. Has been roaming the Zone on his own for quite some time now.
One of the veterans. Knows the Zone like the back of his hand. Usually well equipped and highly dangerous.

Experienced smuggler. For a long time, plied his trade in Africa and South America. The news of the second Chernobyl disaster brought him to Ukraine at once. In a short while, he managed to smuggle hundreds of stuffed mutants out of the restricted area and earned the nickname "Taxidermist". When not "working" in the Zone, he is a successful trader. Loves fancy suits and posh ties, for combat he prefers Soviet era weapons.

Took part in the Soviet invasion of Afghanistan. Formerly an atheist, but after surviving an ambush and brutal torture at the hands of the Mujahideen, he emerged a religious man. After the war in Afghanistan, he emigrated to Poland where he enrolled into a theological seminary. Having graduated from the seminary, he preached at the Catholic church in Lvov. After the second explosion at the Chernobyl NPP, he volunteered to help the victims. He's been preaching in the Zone ever since that time, going on a few years now.

Formerly a mechanic at the "KholodMach" plant. After his wife left him, he decided to take his own life. However, being deeply religious, he could not carry out the act himself, so he hoped the Zone would do it for him. Contrary to his expectations, he survived all that the Zone threw at him. He has gained invaluable experience and has won the respect of other stalkers thanks to his driven attitude and solid decision making skills. Master is probably the most qualified mechanic in the Zone, and is capable at repairing all manner of equipment and even heavy vehicles. Lately has taken to installing security systems for the various armed faction of the Zone in exchange for decent pay. His neutrality makes him welcome everywhere he goes. A simple, stern man, a bit rough around the edges when provoked.

Former military stalker, used to be a lieutenant colonel in the Ministry of the Interior. The only soldier to return from a disastrous operation deep in the Zone, later discovered that the mission was utterly pointless and downright suicidal due to poor planning by the higher-ups. Totally disillusioned with the goals of the military, he decided never to return and staged his own death. He very quickly became an independent stalker and fell in with the Loners. Quiet, cynical, firm of purpose and disciplined.
A rookie. Completely green and new to the Zone.

Klutz is 20 years old, a child compared to many of the guys in the Zone. He lost everything and everyone in the Big Land before deciding to try his here. He can barely manage to make a living, yet he simply has no other place to go to. For this reason, he owes money to many stalkers and often continues to borrow more just to buy food and water. Travels the Zone in search of opportunities but never goes alone, instead he usually tags along with groups of experienced Stalkers. Not a popular companion amongst the loners, because more often than not, he's plain useless and contributes little.
An experienced stalker. Equipment suggests experience with sniping, ex-military origins likely.
A veteran stalker. Has seen plenty in the Zone, and knows how to navigate safely and which areas to avoid.

Oleg "the Fiend" Gusarov. A former "Black Beret", served in the Belotserkovskaya Spetsnaz brigade. Served multiple tours, became a master sergeant. An expert sniper and an explosives technician. A loner at heart, never ventures into the Zone with a group, preferring to act alone. He received many offers to join up with the various faction operating in the Zone, but always refused.

A student from the Department of Physics who dropped out during his senior year. Like many other desperates, he left for the Zone in search of easy money. Likes to show off his "scientific" knowledge and discourse on abstract philosophical issues. That's reason enough for other stalkers not to like him too much. Overall, a pretty decent fellow. A kind of idealist.

Sparrow is 27 years old, cunning, and farseeing, but also capable of the worst blunders. Can be mean. A rather dubious persona. A scrawny and pallid type. Came to the Zone out of curiosity, promising himself he would return home after a couple of months. He never did. On his very first sally into the Zone, Sparrow managed to cross an infamous field strewn with deadly anomalies barehanded, no protective gear or detector, and was apparently completely oblivious about what he managed to do and just how dangerous it was. When someone told him how close he came to having every bone in his body turned into splinters, he passed out. Since then, celebrates that date (October 9th) as his second birthday.
Squad leader from the Freedom faction. Expert Zone survivor, often hired as a guide through anomalous areas.
Stalker from the Freedom faction. Carefree, likes to smoke up and coexist peacefully with the Zone.
Stalker from the Freedom faction. A sharpshooter, very good at spotting and killing bloodsuckers.
Militant from the Freedom faction. From the way he carries himself, likely ex spec-ops origin.

Leshiy, as his brother calls him, came to the Zone a young idealist. However, after a few years of living a hair's breadth away from death, he gradually turned into a cynical realist. Considers the Zone his home, and considers those killed by the Zone's many dangers as having been unworthy to share this home with him.
Writes stories and creates sketches about the Zone under the name of Arkady. A former journalist. Meticulous and harsh, but fair. Widely respected by the stalkers.
A veteran stalker who got too close to a controller.
Rookie stalker who foolishly wandered too close to the scorcher.
Seasoned stalker who met his match tangling with a controller.
Bandit leader's personal bodyguard. Most likely an ex-soldier from the big land, without a doubt a fugitive in his home country.
Seasoned bandit, robbed more loners than he can count, probably killed twice that number.
Rookie bandit, couldn't cut it like all the honest loners so he resorted to stealing the loot those more skilled than him.
Experienced bandit, effective at sniffing out ways to make easy money, often at the expense of the honest folk.

Leader of the bandit gang occupying an old construction site in the northern part of the Dark Valley. Rumors say he's a real beast, likes to take hostages for ransom and executes them with impunity if no payment is given. Apparently sitting on a whole hoard of wealth. Keeps his gang organized and in check through sheer terror and fear, for this reason quite a few of his subordinates plot against him.
Borov
Stalker from the Duty faction. Average grunt, often on security detail at the fringes of Duty territory.
Stalker from the Monolith group. Average soldier but not to be underestimated, known for unexpected and unorthodox tactics.
A stalker from the Duty faction. Captured by bandits operating in Dark Valley.
Shaggy Sergei
Seasoned stalker from the Duty faction. Part of a recon squad operating in the Dark Valley.
Bullet
Regular soldier, standard gear and armament of the Ukrainian military.
Spetsnaz operator. Well equipped, highly trained, born to kill.
Experienced stalker, has been in the Zone long enough to gain a reputation.
Rookie stalker. New to the Zone, still learning the ropes.
Ghost
Veteran researcher of the Zone. Participated in the first science expeditions of 2007.
Professor Sakharov
Research assistant at the mobile lab, capable scientist working in the Zone hoping to make a name for himself with a new discovery.
Assistant Semenov
Vasiliev
